channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Sacituzumab tirumotecan boosts survival over platinum chemotherapy in final phase 3 results
item.description: Final company-reported results showed sacituzumab tirumotecan improved overall survival versus platinum-based chemotherapy in EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC.

item.title: Tarlatamab plus durvalumab improves survival in extensive-stage SCLC, Amgen interim phase 3 shows
item.description: Amgen reported that tarlatamab plus durvalumab improved overall survival versus durvalumab alone in first-line maintenance for extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.

item.title: Camupepimut fails to improve disease-free survival in pancreatic cancer in phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P trial
item.description: In the randomized phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P trial, camupepimut did not improve disease-free survival versus observation in patients with resected KRAS-mutated pancreatic cancer.

item.title: Unexpected Link Between Education and Delayed MS Diagnosis
item.description: Higher education levels are unexpectedly linked to greater odds of delayed MS diagnosis, and limited access to MS specialists also emerges as a factor.
